listing.name: Payout Multiplier1.0.0
listing.summary: A long awaited (by like, maybe 2 people) sequel to Payout Tweaker. CHANGE mission REWARDS! change BOUNTY REWARDS! Lunalib integration for changeable settings WITHOUT restart! THREE TIMES the settings!
listing.aiSummary: Changes mission and bounty rewards with adjustable multipliers.

description: Allows players to modify mission and bounty payout values. It integrates with Lunalib to allow settings changes without restarting the game. The mod offers three times as many settings as its predecessor.
